2026_043_january_2026_p_card_report.paragraph: Troy School District's purchasing-card (PCARD) expenditure report for January 2026, carried on the Board of Education agenda of March 17, 2026, itemizes every card transaction coded to the journal entry "JANUARY 2026 PCARD EXP," with columns for transaction date, merchant description, business-unit number, account and amount. Page footers run from 1 to 39, each stamped 3/11/26, and the schedule closes with a printed total of 266,350.72. The largest single line is 6,450.00 to MOSYLE COR MO on 1/29/26 under business unit 101790284000000, account 3450; other outsized entries include 5,629.27 at HYATT REG CHIC on 1/14/26 and two PAY YMCA CAMP charges of 5,113.95 and 5,150.00 on 1/28/26.
